response.description: Implement an architecture-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures recommendation behavior using the trained model and available public interaction data. Preserve DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis).
response.motivation: Give the evolution process measured evidence about model behavior while preserving the RecHarness evaluation protocol. Diagnostics guide candidate improvements; selection remains the macro-average validation HR@10 across all four datasets.
response.implementation_notes: Use view.model as the authoritative trained module and adapt feature extraction and scoring probes when its architecture changes. Process batches shaped B x L, masking padding and invalid targets. Suitable diagnostics include positive-versus-negative score margins, valid-position pairwise accuracy, embedding norms, recommendation coverage, and training-frequency popularity exposure. Define each metric's formula, aggregation, sample count, and limitations. For recommendation diagnostics, use twenty real training users, five per category, and rank the full catalog after excluding their observed training items. Preserve dataset routing and restore the model's original training mode after diagnosis. Only use histories, titles, descriptions, and available timestamps; report unsupported measurements as unavailable. Do not infer ratings, review sentiment, or simulator diversity/conformity traits. Keep artifacts beneath the trial directory and DATA_DIR sourced from os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'].
response.pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
  run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
    save model training mode
    set view.model to evaluation mode
    under no_grad:
      for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
        derive architecture-compatible features
        score positive and negative targets
        accumulate masked margins and pairwise accuracy
      measure item-embedding statistics where applicable
      select five real training users per category reproducibly
      rank each user's full category catalog, excluding training-seen items
      accumulate coverage and training-popularity exposure
    restore model training mode
    return {metrics: finalized measurements, metric_definitions: formulas and limitations}

def diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
  return prompt containing measured metrics and their definitions,
         requesting evidence-linked hypotheses and explicitly identifying
         unavailable signals and uncertainty

originality.positive: Connects model diagnostics, architecture compatibility, and constrained simulator inputs in a reproducible adapter.
originality.negative: The individual diagnostic techniques are established; the contribution is primarily integration.

future_potential.positive: Can support targeted experiments and comparisons across evolving recommendation architectures.
future_potential.negative: Diagnostic improvements may not improve validation HR@10, and twenty users provide limited behavioral coverage.

code_difficulty.positive: The compatibility interface and batch format provide clear implementation boundaries.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, architecture-specific scoring, full-catalog ranking, and consistent metric definitions require care.
